name: ms_pe_gate2
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${R1_ARGS:-}" ]; then python -m babylm.configs.make_base_jobs --r1 $R1_ARGS; fi; python -m babylm.moonshot.mini_ruler | tee _logs/mini_ruler.log; cp babylm/configs/jobs_moonshot_pe_gate2_S_after_f1.json _logs/; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py

jobs.name: ms_pe_gate2
jobs.cmd: v2d S=babylm/runs/$r/score; mkdir -p $S; gsutil -m -q rsync -r __BUCKET__/dumps_in/$r $S 2>/dev/null; [ -f $S/hf/config.json ] || { echo "[dumpv2] skip $r (not staged)"; return 0; }; CK=; [ -f $S/dev_bpw_twin.json ] && CK="--check $S/dev_bpw_twin.json"; mkdir -p babylm/runs/_dumps_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --out babylm/runs/_dumps_v2/$r.npz $CK > _logs/dumpv2_$r.log 2>&1 && echo "[dumpv2] ok $r ${CK:+checked}" || echo "[dumpv2] FAILED $r"; }; nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d; set -- $V2_RUNS; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; shift; b=${1:-}; [ -n "$b" ] && shift; v2d $a & if [ -n "$b" ]; then v2d $b & fi; wait; done; echo quit | nvidia-cuda-mps-control; cell python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs $CFG --only $n --device cuda || echo "[f1] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[f1] score $n failed"; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/$n/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/$n/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/$n/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo "[twin] $n failed"; case $n in ms_f1_m[0-7]) mkdir -p babylm/runs/_dumps; S=babylm/runs/$n/score; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/_dumps/$n.npz --check $S/dev_bpw.json > _logs/dump_$n.log 2>&1 && echo "[dump] ok $n" || echo "[dump] FAILED $n"; mkdir -p babylm/runs/_dumps_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --out babylm/runs/_dumps_v2/$n.npz --check $S/dev_bpw_twin.json > _logs/dumpv2_$n.log 2>&1 && echo "[dumpv2] ok $n" || echo "[dumpv2] FAILED $n";; esac; }; }; stage do echo "[solo] $n"; ( cell $n ) > _logs/cell_$n.log 2>&1; done; }; stage "$CELLS1"; stage "$CELLS2"; pe python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_moonshot_pe_gate2_S_after_f1.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[pe] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] || return 0; bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[pe] score $n failed"; S=babylm/runs/$n/score; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out $S/dev_bpw_twin.json > $S/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1; mkdir -p babylm/runs/_dumps_v2/pe_g2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/_dumps_v2/pe_g2/$n.npz --check $S/dev_bpw_twin.json > _logs/pe_dump_$n.log 2>&1 && echo "[pe] dump ok $n" || echo "[pe] dump FAILED $n"; case $n in *PE3*|*NJ*) CK=$(ls babylm/runs/$n/checkpoints/chck_*M.pt || sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2); M=babylm/runs/$n/members; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.particle_members $CK --out $M > _logs/pe_members_$n.log 2>&1 || { echo "[pe] members FAILED $n"; return 0; }; for mk in $M/member_*.pt; do k=$(basename $mk .pt); H=$M/$k; ( /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.export_hf --ckpt $mk --out $H/hf --verify && /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py $H/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out $H/dev_bpw_twin.json && /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $H/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/_dumps_v2/pe_g2/${n}__$k.npz --check $H/dev_bpw_twin.json ) > _logs/pe_${n}_$k.log 2>&1 && echo "[pe] member ok $n $k" || echo "[pe] member FAILED $n $k"; done;; esac; }; if [ "${PE_G2:-0}" = 1 ]; then for n in ms_pe_g2_PE3_s0 ms_pe_g2_NJ_s0 ms_pe_g2_Fdeep_s0; do pe $n; done; fi

note: PE Gate 2 standalone (moonshot 'PE Gate 0 confirmed' 11:3xZ; pool moonshot, Atila 'yes run' 04:36Z covers the moonshot pool). Same SOLO A100 condition as ms_f1_stage1 (critic ref-0296 reuse of ms_f1_m0-2/FM): stage 3 only (PE3, NJ, F-deep), 1M, solo, sequential. Dumps get the temps grid (dev_bpw_dump ref-0034). Outputs _dumps_v2/pe_g2/ -> shared/babylm/moonshot/dumps_v2/pe_g2/.
